_help.units: Radians (model joint values, the so101 standard), the gripper too. Degree equivalents: 0.1 rad = 5.7 deg, 0.17 rad = 9.7 deg.
_help.joint_limits: Soft limits per joint, [min, max] in radians. SafeFollower clamps every target into this range. The defaults are the model's joint range minus about 0.1 rad; wrist_roll is limited to well under a full turn. Tighten them to keep the arm away from the table, cables and itself (see docs/safety.md).
_help.max_step: Largest change of a joint target per send_action, in radians. A far target is reached over several commands. At 30 fps, 0.17 rad per command is about 300 deg/s; a faster loop moves faster. The gripper default 0.38 rad is about 20 % of its range.
